name: rolling-chorus-banish-two-total-reserve-six-does-not-draw
notes: Rolling Chorus (IZVXDYjcSL): banishing Dungeon Guide and Fluffy Shopkeep (reserve 3 each) totals 6 < 15, so nothing is drawn.

rulesClauses: Banish up to two target cards from a single graveyard. If the total reserve cost of the banished cards is 15 or greater, draw a card into your memory.
